SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Gramm ar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Continuous Tense, part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade six ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: What are you doing; What were you doing yesterday? What will you be doing tomorrow?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
